sources: Charak, Elements of Vedic Astrology — ch. VII (significations) and XVII (lords of houses).
Deborah Houlding, The Houses: Temples of the Sky — house derivation and classical topics.
Sutton, The Essentials of Vedic Astrology — bhavas and the four purusharthas.
reading_rules: Judge a house three ways: occupants, its lord's placement and dignity, and aspects onto it. All three must be weighed before a verdict.
An empty house is normal and is not weak. The payout simply runs through the lord.

Bhavat bhavam: the matter of a house is confirmed by the same count taken again from it — the 7th from the 7th (the lagna) for marriage, the 4th from the 4th (the 7th) for property, the 9th from the 9th (the 5th) for fortune.
Kendradhipati dosha: a natural benefic owning a kendra loses beneficence; a natural malefic owning a kendra gains it.
A trikona lord is always benefic for that lagna; a lord of 3, 6 or 11 is always functionally malefic.
Dusthana lords placed in another dusthana form vipreeta raja yoga — relief through reversal.
The most reliable single strength test in a natal chart is the condition of the lagna lord and the 9th lord.

1.topics: self, body, vitality, head, general fortune, how you arrive in a room
1.detail: The lagna is the chart's engine. Every other promise is delivered through the strength of the 1st house and its lord. A weak lagna lord shrinks even a strong raja yoga.

2.topics: accumulated wealth, speech, food, face, immediate family, values
2.body: face, right eye, mouth, teeth, throat, tongue
2.detail: Savings rather than income — the 11th earns, the 2nd keeps. Also the voice, literally and as reputation. A maraka house: its lord governs the body's exit as well as its sustenance.

3.topics: courage, initiative, younger siblings, short travel, hands, skill, writing
3.detail: An upachaya house: malefics here improve over time. This is the house of self-effort — the part of the chart that is not inherited.

4.topics: home, mother, land, vehicles, education's foundation, inner contentment
4.detail: The seat of the chart — what you return to. Also the house of the final resting place, and of whether the mind has a floor under it.

5.topics: children, intelligence, romance, speculation, mantra, past-life merit
5.detail: Purva punya — the credit balance carried in. The 5th shows what comes easily because it was earned before. It is also the house of mantra, and therefore of remedy.

6.topics: work and service, illness, debt, enemies, litigation, daily routine, pets
6.detail: A dusthana that is also an upachaya: it hurts, and it improves with effort. Strong 6th = the ability to out-work opposition, at the price of never quite resting.

7.topics: marriage, partner, business partnership, public dealings, the other person
7.body: pelvis, lower back, reproductive organs, urinary tract
7.detail: The mirror house — whatever the 1st will not own, the 7th delivers through another person. Also a maraka: the second exit door of the chart.

8.topics: longevity, transformation, inheritance, tax and insurance, the occult, in-laws, sudden events
8.body: external genitals, anus, chronic and hidden conditions
8.detail: The house of what you did not choose. It is the house of longevity, not of death; PocketAstro reads it for endurance, research capacity and other people's money, never for a date.

9.topics: fortune, father, guru, long travel, higher learning, law, faith
9.detail: The single most fortunate house. Its lord's condition sets the ceiling on luck — a strong 9th lord rescues a difficult chart more reliably than any yoga.

10.topics: career, status, public name, authority, action in the world
10.body: knees, joints, bones of the leg
10.detail: Not the job but the standing. Judge with the D10 (dashamsa) before making a career call. An empty 10th is normal — the payout runs through the 10th lord.

11.topics: gains, income, elder siblings, friends, networks, fulfilment of desire
11.detail: Income, as distinct from savings. The 11th is the strongest upachaya — even malefics gain here. Its shadow is that desire keeps regenerating.

12.topics: expenditure, loss, foreign lands, sleep, isolation, liberation, the bed
12.detail: Everything that leaves — money, sleep, the country, the self. A strong 12th is not poverty; it is a person whose real life happens off-stage.

lord_in_house.1-1: The 1st lord carries the body, the name and the personal engine of the chart into the 1st — the body and the name: it becomes personal: the native carries it themselves, visibly, and is identified with it. Sound health and a long constitution; the chart stands on its own feet.
lord_in_house.1-2: The 1st lord carries the body, the name and the personal engine of the chart into the 2nd — savings, speech and family: it is monetised and spoken about; family becomes a stakeholder.
lord_in_house.1-3: The 1st lord carries the body, the name and the personal engine of the chart into the 3rd — effort, craft and siblings: it has to be worked for by hand; results come through initiative and short reach, not through position.

Health and opposition are both live themes; if afflicted, illness and rivals — if clean, the native destroys opposition and earns from their own labour.
lord_in_house.1-7: The 1st lord carries the body, the name and the personal engine of the chart into the 7th — partnership and the public: it arrives through another person: spouse, partner, or the public; rarely alone.

Results are real but not on schedule. Longevity is supported but health is not; good for occult and research work, hard on the body's comfort. Read Saturn before judging.

lord_in_house.9-9: The 9th lord carries fortune, father, teachers, law and long travel into the 9th — fortune, father and dharma: it is blessed: luck, teachers, law and long travel carry it further than effort alone would. Very fortunate — the classical marker of a life with luck on tap.
lord_in_house.9-10: The 9th lord carries fortune, father, teachers, law and long travel into the 10th — career and status: it becomes public and professional; the native is known for it. Dharma and career align: status through legitimate, principled work. A first-class raja-yoga cell.
lord_in_house.9-11: The 9th lord carries fortune, father, teachers, law and long travel into the 11th — income, friends and networks: it multiplies: gains, patrons and networks feed it, and it grows over the life. Continuous inflow of money, long life, and standing through belief or teaching.
lord_in_house.9-12: The 9th lord carries fortune, father, teachers, law and long travel into the 12th — loss, foreign ground and retreat: it is spent, exported, or given up; it works abroad, in private, or not at all in the obvious form. Fortune is spent on charity and pilgrimage; honoured abroad rather than at home.
lord_in_house.10-1: The 10th lord carries career, status and public action into the 1st — the body and the name: it becomes personal: the native carries it themselves, visibly, and is identified with it. Progressive rise in wealth and learning; sickly in childhood, healthy later.
lord_in_house.10-2: The 10th lord carries career, status and public action into the 2nd — savings, speech and family: it is monetised and spoken about; family becomes a stakeholder.
lord_in_house.10-3: The 10th lord carries career, status and public action into the 3rd — effort, craft and siblings: it has to be worked for by hand; results come through initiative and short reach, not through position.
lord_in_house.10-4: The 10th lord carries career, status and public action into the 4th — home, mother and land: it moves indoors: home, mother, property and peace of mind become the channel.
lord_in_house.10-5: The 10th lord carries career, status and public action into the 5th — children, intellect and merit: it runs through intelligence, creativity, children, or something already earned in a past cycle.
lord_in_house.10-6: The 10th lord carries career, status and public action into the 6th — work, debt and opposition: it costs friction: service, debt, litigation or health become the route, and the result is won rather than given. Skilled but obstructed; the career fights for every inch. Health, however, holds.

lord_in_house.10-9: The 10th lord carries career, status and public action into the 9th — fortune, father and dharma: it is blessed: luck, teachers, law and long travel carry it further than effort alone would. A king or their modern equivalent — the strongest career cell.
lord_in_house.10-10: The 10th lord carries career, status and public action into the 10th — career and status: it becomes public and professional; the native is known for it. Truthful, capable and comfortable; the career is the life.
lord_in_house.10-11: The 10th lord carries career, status and public action into the 11th — income, friends and networks: it multiplies: gains, patrons and networks feed it, and it grows over the life.

Work abroad, or work that is deliberately out of public view. Expenditure through authority.

Spendthrift tendency and a body that needs deliberate care; often a life lived away from where it started.
